description: This file contains the abstract base class 'Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase' for the Smarty template compiler. It defines core properties and methods for compiling Smarty templates, including plugin management, tag compilation, error handling, and source filtering. The class serves as a foundational component for Smarty's template compilation process.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for Smarty's template compiler, providing core functionalities such as plugin handling, tag compilation, source filtering, error reporting, and source code management for the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty template using source code and filters, producing a compiled code frame.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Reads the template source, applies pre-filters, compiles it, and optionally applies post-filters, returning the final compiled code.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Applies registered post-filters to the compiled code.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Applies registered pre-filters to the raw template source.

methods.name: compileTag
methods.description: Compiles a specific Smarty tag by name with given attributes and parameters.

methods.name: compileVariable
methods.description: Compiles a template variable into PHP code for output.

methods.name: compileConfigVariable
methods.description: Compiles a configuration variable reference into PHP code.

methods.name: compilePHPFunctionCall
methods.description: Generates PHP code for calling a PHP function or plugin within a template.

methods.name: syntaxMatchesVariable
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern of a valid PHP variable syntax.

methods.name: processText
methods.description: Minifies and processes text sections, removing unnecessary whitespace and tags.

methods.name: callTagCompiler
methods.description: Lazily loads and invokes the appropriate internal tag compiler plugin.

methods.name: getTagCompiler
methods.description: Loads and caches tag compiler plugin classes by name.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves or loads a plugin function or class method based on plugin name and type.

methods.name: getPluginFromDefaultHandler
methods.description: Uses the default plugin handler to find plugins if not already available.

methods.name: appendCode
methods.description: Concatenates code snippets, removing redundant PHP close/open tags.

methods.name: processNocacheCode
methods.description: Wraps code sections for nocache output, injecting special Smarty cache markers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Extracts the identifier from a variable or string input.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Extracts variable name from a template variable string.

methods.name: setNocacheInVariable
methods.description: Marks a template variable as nocache.

methods.name: convertScope
methods.description: Converts and validates scope attribute values to internal scope identifiers.

methods.name: makeNocacheCode
methods.description: Generates PHP code for nocache sections with cache markers.

methods.name: trigger_template_error
methods.description: Reports a compilation or parsing error with detailed context, potentially throwing an exception.

methods.name: getVarExport
methods.description: Returns a PHP var_export string with whitespace removed for code inclusion.

methods.name: enterDoubleQuote
methods.description: Tracks entry into a double-quoted string for string parsing state.

methods.name: getTagStackCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of open tags in the parser stack.

methods.name: replaceDelimiter
methods.description: Replaces delimiter placeholders in regex patterns for parsing.

methods.name: initDelimiterPreg
methods.description: Initializes regex patterns for template delimiters and literals.

methods.name: leaveDoubleQuote
methods.description: Verifies and exits a double-quoted string, throwing errors if unclosed.

methods.name: getLdelPreg
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern of the left delimiter.

methods.name: getRdelPreg
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern of the right delimiter.

methods.name: getLdelLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the left delimiter.

methods.name: getRdelLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the right delimiter.

methods.name: getOpenBlockTag
methods.description: Returns the name of the current open block tag.

methods.name: isVariable
methods.description: Checks if a value contains variable references.

methods.name: getNewPrefixVariable
methods.description: Generates a new unique prefix variable name.

methods.name: getPrefixVariable
methods.description: Returns the current prefix variable name.

methods.name: appendPrefixCode
methods.description: Appends code to the prefix code buffer.

methods.name: getPrefixCode
methods.description: Concatenates prefix code snippets into a single string.

methods.name: saveRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Saves the current state of required plugins, optionally resetting.

methods.name: restoreRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Restores previously saved plugin requirements.

methods.name: compileRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Generates code to check and include required plugins.

methods.name: compileCheckPlugins
methods.description: Creates code to verify plugin availability.

methods.name: doCompile
methods.description: Abstract method for compiling template source; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: cStyleComment
methods.description: Converts a string into a C-style comment.

methods.name: compileTag2
methods.description: Internal method to compile a specific tag, handling plugin resolution and error reporting.
